the  credit  of  the  fund  of  the  Body  Corporate  through  the
External Resources Department of the General Treasury .
(2) The  Body  Corporate  may  establish  a  depreciation
fund  or  a  sinking  fund  for  the  purpose  of  rehabilitation,
development or improvement of the Body Corporate.
(3) There shall be paid out of the fund all sums of the
money  to  defray  any  expenditure  incurred  by  the  Body
Corporate in the exercise, performance and discharge of its
powers, duties and functions under this Act.
(4) The financial year of the Body Corporate shall be
1st April to 31st March of the following year.
9. All  debts  and  liabilities  of  the  Institute  existing  on
the day preceding  the date of commencement of this Act,
shall be paid and discharged by the Body Corporate hereby
constituted  and  all  debts  due  to,  subscriptions  and
contributions  payable  to  the  Institute  on  that  day  shall  be
paid to the Body Corporate  made under and for the purpose
of this Act.
10. No  member  of  the  Body  Corporate  shall  for  the
purpose of discharging the debts and liabilities of the Body
Corporate or for any other  purpose, be liable to make any
contribution exceeding the amount due from such  member
as  membership fee without his consent.

11.
(1) The Body Corporate shall cause proper accounts
to  be  kept  of  its  income,  expenditure,  and  all  other
transactions of the Body Corporate.
(2) The accounts of the Body Corporate shall be audited
by a Qualified Auditor.
